name: Number of egg-laying hens in cages
descriptionShort: Includes battery and enriched cage systems.
descriptionProcessing:
- Data for the UK, US, and EU member states are sourced from official statistics. Data for other countries are taken from a compilation by the Welfare Footprint Institute, which combines national statistics and industry reports.
- For the UK, hen housing counts and shares are approximated from the share of eggs produced in each housing type, due to limited data availability.
- For the US, pastured hens are included under free-range, and organic hens not reported as free-range or pastured are included under barn or aviary.

origins.title: Laying hens by way of keeping
origins.description: Number of laying hens in EU member states by housing system (non-enriched cages, enriched cages, free range, barn, and organic), as reported by member states under Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/1185.
origins.citationFull: European Commission - Laying hens by way of keeping (2026), Directorate-General for Agriculture and Rural Development.

origins.title: Livestock populations in the United Kingdom
origins.description: Annual estimates of livestock populations for the United Kingdom based on the June Survey and Census of Agriculture. Includes total numbers of laying hens and pullets by year.
origins.citationFull: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs. Livestock populations in the United Kingdom (2026). Defra.

origins.title: UK egg statistics
origins.description: Defra runs a quarterly voluntary survey of 27 registered UK egg packing stations, covering around 75% of eggs packed in the UK, with a response rate of typically 100 per cent. It collects data on egg throughput by production type (enriched cage, barn, free range, organic), which are used to estimate UK-level figures.
origins.citationFull: Quarterly UK statistics on Egg Packing Station Throughput and Prices, by the Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs of the United Kingdom.

origins.title: Egg Markets Overview
origins.description: A weekly publication of the USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Livestock and Poultry Program, Agricultural Analytics Division.
origins.citationFull: United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) - Egg Markets Overview, USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Livestock and Poultry Program, Agricultural Analytics Division.
